What Sales Contributes to Cardinal Health
Direct Sales is responsible for driving sales and services to new and existing customers through face-to-face and virtual interactions to achieve individual and organizational sales objectives.
Sales professionals focus on developing new business opportunities, strengthening customer relationships, expanding customer access, and driving sustainable revenue growth. Through consultative selling and clinical engagement, this function supports customer acquisition, account penetration, and strategic business development across targeted healthcare institutions.
Job Summary
The Product Specialist is responsible for driving business growth and customer engagement within the assigned territory covering the Seoul metropolitan area and selected regional territories in South Korea.
This field-based role partners with healthcare professionals, hospital procurement teams, and key decision-makers to promote Cardinal Health products and support customer needs.
The Product Specialist contributes to business growth through new account acquisition, account penetration, and strategic customer development.
Responsibilities
Identify and develop new business opportunities within target hospitals and healthcare institutions.
Drive customer acquisition and expand Cardinal Health presence in strategic accounts.
Build relationships with clinicians, procurement teams and key decision-makers.
Provide product education, training and clinical support.
Develop and execute territory and account plans aligned with business priorities.
Analyze market trends and customer insights to identify growth opportunities.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders to support business growth.
Qualifications
2-5 years of sales experience managing ICU accounts within tertiary hospitals.
2-5 years of combined experience in the medical device and/or pharmaceutical industry.
Proven experience engaging healthcare professionals, procurement teams and key decision-makers.
Experience in new account development and customer relationship management.
Bachelor degree preferred.
Basic command of Business English.
What is Expected of You and Others at This Level
Independently manages customer relationships and sales opportunities.
Identifies and develops new account opportunities.
Develops and executes territory and account plans.
Demonstrates accountability, initiative and execution excellence.
